verdict.stance: Overweight / Oman National Block 6 Oil & Gas Anchor (<1x Leverage)
verdict.summary: EDO holds Oman's 60% stake in Block 6 (PDO oil & gas) generating $14.77bn FY25 revenue and ~$8.3bn S&P-adjusted EBITDA. The 2025 conversion of $3.31bn shareholder loans into equity lifted equity to $11.63bn and kept leverage below 1.0x, offering spread pickup over Oman sovereign.

positives: Low-cost Block 6 hydrocarbon concession representing >60% of Oman's crude/gas output with >15-year reserve life.
Deleveraged structure (<1.0x net leverage) strengthened by $3.31bn shareholder loan-to-equity conversion in 2025.
100% Government of Oman ownership with direct fiscal linkage (BBB- S&P / BBB+ Fitch).
negatives: High royalty/tax take ($5.2bn royalties in FY25) compresses bottom-line net margin ($523m FY25 net profit).
Sustained Brent below $65/bbl pressures FFO after sovereign distributions and Block 6 sustaining capex.

background.business_overview: Oman's state-owned energy vehicle holding 60% of Block 6 oil & 100% of Block 6 gas.

background.ownership_governance: 100% owned by the Government of the Sultanate of Oman.
